values.note: Water/electric $50, water/electric/sewer $60, lakeside $60; boondocking $30 and tent sites $30. Seasonal RV sites $2,500 (standard) or $2,800 (premium). Cancelling more than 5 days out is refunded less $10; 5 days or less, 50%.

note: City of Moose Lake campground on the north end of Moosehead Lake, with a swimming beach (no lifeguard) and boat landing; adjoins City Park and the Munger Trail. ATVs may ride to and from sites to reach the Soo Line North trail. Some sites go to seasonal campers. --Claude
summary: 2026 city fee schedule and Campspot engine/park map read via headless browser: W/E $50, full hookup or lakeside $60 (+tax), boondock/tent $30, seasonal $2,500-2,800; showers, flush toilets, dump; Campspot booking. Lakefront kept (city sells a nightly 'Lakeside' class; open-lawn pads 10-25 m from shore). Campspot lists no site types for any date read.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront kept: the city's fee schedule sells 'RV Camping - Lakeside per Night' at $60, so lakeside sites are nightly. On Esri imagery the pads on the south side of the lower campground lane (about 46.4538,-92.7549 east to 46.4540,-92.7537) sit ~10-25 m (west) to ~25-45 m (east row) from the shore over open mown lawn, with the docks below them; the Campspot map draws a row of pads along the shore east of the inlet and three by the inlet. Site NUMBERS are not published anywhere read (the Campspot map is unnumbered and the engine lists no site types out of season), so the lakeside site numbers could not be named.

FEES: nightly_low set to $50 (cheapest RV hookup site). The fee schedule also lists 'Boondocking per Night $30' - if that is a dry RV site a 23-ft motorhome may take, the low would be $30; the schedule does not say what boondocking means here. Reviewer call.

OHV: Campspot lists 'OHV Trails' as a nearby activity and its terms make guests acknowledge the city ATV ordinance and the Soo Line North trail map ('Motor bikes and ATVs are to be used only to and from campsites'). A general city campground with an OHV side, not a staging camp: stays, caveat added.

LONG-STAY (local): seasonal RV rates ($2,500/$2,800) are posted, so some sites are seasonal; nightly share not published. Campspot rating 4.5 from 466 reviews; the rules are written for nightly campers ('Check in time is 3:00 p.m. Checkout time is at 2:00 p.m.').

SEASON: not read this pass (the Campspot listing returns no types and no closure for any date tried). The 2026-10-13 price-research read saw Campspot closures 2026-10-01..2027-04-30, i.e. open May 1-Sep 30; left absent here.
SITES: the stored count 82 (22 full, 43 W/E, 17 tent from old note prose) is not stated by any city or Campspot page read; left as stored. Reviewer may clear it.

WEBSITE: https://www.campspot.com/park/moose-lake-city-campground (marketplace slug, resolves) -> https://www.campspot.com/book/moose-lake-park (the city's own link) is optional; the city has no campground page of its own. Phone 218-485-4761 confirmed (city directory, Campspot).
Pin 46.45360,-92.75470 is at the docks ~80 m south of the site centroid (Campspot's own point 46.454175,-92.754009 is ~85 m NE); no move.
